ui_bugs.issue: On page mount, when GET /loop/active returns a paused_for_user loop with context.kind='human_review_required' (or requires_human_review=true), the hydrate branch at ChatPanel.jsx ~line 860-873 only calls setLoopId + setLoopPhase('paused_for_user') + openLoopStream — it does NOT setUserAction with gateType='ship_human_review' from the doc's context. Result: on reload of a real ship_human_review pause, user sees the top 'LOOP · PAUSED · YOUR INPUT' banner and 'Opening ship stream…' indefinitely, but never the actionable UserActionCard with Approve & Ship / Cancel buttons or the countdown chip. Waited 15+s for SSE frame — none arrives (the SSE stream for a seeded/paused session does not re-emit state on connect). This breaks Item 9's 'survives reload' acceptance for the ship_human_review variant.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /loop/status returns full doc.context with kind=human_review_required, tests_touched, message, expires_at, workcard_enabled=true — data is correct. Frontend just doesn't consume it in the hydrate path.

action_items: Item 9 fix (HIGH): In ChatPanel.jsx `paused_for_user` hydrate branch (~line 860), inspect active.context (or issue a follow-up GET /loop/{id}/status) and if context.kind === 'human_review_required' || context.requires_human_review → setUserAction({phase, gateType:'ship_human_review', message, testsTouched, ...}); if context.kind === 'awaiting_ship' → setShipPending via mapShipPendingFromAwaitingShipEvent; else setUserAction with the generic errors payload. Same treatment on the countdown-poll tick so a fresh browser sees the card without waiting for a state transition.
Consider making /loop/{id}/stream re-emit the current terminal-gate state on SSE connect (belt+braces), so any client that reconnects mid-pause gets a synthetic paused_for_user frame.

rca of the issue: Bug: Item 9 — ship_human_review UserActionCard doesn't render after page reload for a paused_for_user loop. Reproduction: (1) seed loop_sessions with state=paused_for_user, phase=ship, context.kind=human_review_required, requires_human_review=true, tests_touched=[...]. (2) log in as test_admin_001, go to /dashboard. (3) observe top banner 'LOOP · PAUSED · YOUR INPUT' + 'Opening ship stream…' — but no UserActionCard, no countdown, no approve/cancel buttons. Root cause: ChatPanel.jsx useEffect on activeProject.project_id (~line 780) fetches /loop/active. Branches: awaiting_confirmation → setLoopPlan; paused_for_user+phase=ship+ship_pending → setShipPending; generic paused_for_user → only setLoopPhase + openLoopStream. Missing: for context.kind==='human_review_required' (or requires_human_review), setUserAction({gateType:'ship_human_review', message, testsTouched, phase}). The SSE stream does not re-emit the current pause frame on reconnect for an already-paused session, so the UI stays blank. Mitigation: add the missing setUserAction/setShipPending branches derived from active.context in the hydrate path, and also feed the countdown-poll tick (line ~894+) with a synthetic userAction if state=paused_for_user and no userAction is set yet. Backend already exposes the required data (context, expires_at, workcard_enabled) — no backend change needed.
